data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism contradicts the claim's own construction: it states that mutations outside the planted failure mode 'were described but not constrained,' but this is inconsistent with the claim that the test 'cannot describe what the subject would have been without' the installation. If the test truly cannot describe the subject absent the failure precondition (as claimed), then it cannot simultaneously describe the 8/9 mutations that fall outside the shown-to-fail-first mode; conversely, if the test does describe those mutations (as the mechanism requires to explain the 3-of-26 distribution), then the claim is false — the test retains its descriptive function for the majority of cases. The target cannot have both: either the installation universally converts the test from describing to constraining (making the distribution inexplicable), or the test describes non-aligned mutations (falsifying the claim that it 'cannot describe').
